items.title: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
items.description: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

items.title: Drone stocks rally after Trump orders tariffs on foreign-made components
items.description: The U.S. is looking to scale defense manufacturing and chip away at China's drone dominance.

items.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case related to UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
items.description: Mangione's lawyers immediately argued his federal plea means he cannot be prosecuted in state court for Brian Thompson's slaying due to double jeopardy.

items.title: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro tells CNBC parks were 'big surprise' in last quarter, company has 'clarity' and 'stability'
items.description: New CEO Josh D'Amaro has said his strategy for continued growth at Disney is centered around storytelling, intellectual property and technology.

items.title: Court rules companies can't import Gilead medications from overseas in blow to AFP health programs
items.description: A U.S. appeals court has ruled in favor of Gilead Sciences against companies known as alternative funding programs that import medicines from overseas.

items.title: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.description: OpenAI's C-suite turnover gives investors another reason for concern as the company pushes toward a mammoth IPO.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
items.description: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."

items.title: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively
items.description: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively and nearly 80% see the U.S. economy negatively.

items.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue
items.description: President Donald Trump tore down the White House East Wing to make way for the ballroom project.

items.title: We're buying more shares of a recent spin-off that has great long-term prospects
items.description: The stock has hit a rough patch since reporting a noisy quarter back in June, as is typical of companies that were spun out.

items.title: Housing investors say this is their worst market in at least 3 years
items.description: Mortgage rates hit a recent low at the end of February but rose sharply at the start of the war with Iran. They are now at their highest level in over a year.

items.title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
items.description: The widening price of copper between two metals exchanges is offering investors a gauge of U.S. tariff risk.

items.title: ‘Absolutely unacceptable’: Japan PM Takaichi condemns Putin’s visit to disputed Kuril Islands
items.description: Japan protested Vladimir Putin’s first visit to the disputed Kuril Islands, escalating tensions over territory claimed by both Tokyo and Moscow.

items.title: NATO aircraft shoot down drone over Latvia, which blames 'Russian electromagnetic warfare'
items.description: NATO fighters shot down a foreign drone over Latvia as Finland briefly restricted airspace and sea areas amid heightened Baltic security concerns.

items.title: Data breach notices have already blown past last year’s total — and AI is playing a growing role
items.description: Data breaches are surging in 2026, with artificial intelligence playing a growing role in cyberattacks, and 'malicious insider' incidents also on the rise.

items.title: U.S. to use economic tactics on Iran 'that have never been seen'; Navy works to relieve troubled carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
items.description: "It will be a combination of economic isolation like ‌the world has ​never seen before, ​and ​the continued blockade in ‌the Strait of ​Hormuz," Bessent said.

items.title: Data centers in space could be a new frontier for insurers — if they can price the risk
items.description: The push to build data centers has moved to lower Earth orbit, and insurers could be facing a new market with plenty of complexity.

items.title: Nintendo shares pop 7% after 'Pokémon Pokopia' sales top 5 million
items.description: Nintendo has been grappling with rising memory prices which forced the company to raise prices of its Switch 2 console which went on sale just over a year ago.

items.title: Trump ally Nigel Farage wins special election to return to UK parliament
items.description: Farage stepped down last month to trigger the vote, branding it a fight against "the establishment," amid controversy over his finances.

items.title: China built robots that can do backflips – but can they make money?
items.description: Unitree’s IPO will gauge investors’ appetite for a technology that has yet to prove its commercial viability amid intensifying geopolitical tensions.
